digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 16 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的轻量级 Rust 编码代理，让 AI 直接在命令行完成代码任务

repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: 统一大模型 API 并内置 Agent 循环与 TUI 终端，一个工具包搞定 AI 编码全流程

repos.name: aaif-goose/goose
repos.description: an open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions - install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM
repos.summary_zh: 开源可扩展 AI 代理，不止写代码，还能装环境、改文件、跑测试，适配任意大模型

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一接入 290+ 模型供应商的 MIT 网关，一个端点搞定 Claude、GPT 等 500+ 模型，90+ 免费源直接白嫖

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 递归搜索文件秒级出结果，自动遵循 gitignore 的 Rust 正则神器，比 grep 快数倍

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管AI伴侣，实时语音对话与Minecraft联动，打造赛博老婆的Neuro-sama级开源方案

repos.name: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx
repos.description: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
repos.summary_zh: 开源自托管的文档管理系统，自动OCR识别、分类归档纸质文件，让海量文档秒级检索

repos.name: rustfs/rustfs
repos.description: 🚀2.3x faster than MinIO for 4KB object payloads. RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration a
repos.summary_zh: 开源 S3 兼容对象存储，4KB 小文件性能比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍，支持无缝迁移与共存

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol
repos.description: Specification and documentation for the Model Context Protocol
repos.summary_zh: AI 与工具间标准化的上下文传输协议，让模型无缝调用外部数据与功能

repos.name: ai-dynamo/dynamo
repos.description: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework
repos.summary_zh: 数据中心级分布式推理服务框架，用 Rust 打造极致吞吐与低延迟，专为大规模 AI 部署而生

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，推理效率惊人

repos.name: avifenesh/memra
repos.description: from-scratch LLM inference for RTX 5090 (sm_120a) and H100 (sm_90a)
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写CUDA内核，专为RTX 5090和H100优化LLM推理，性能直逼原生框架

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，专测细粒度视觉能力短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面神器，自托管替代 TeamViewer，数据完全自主可控

repos.name: koala73/worldmonitor
repos.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational aw
repos.summary_zh: 实时全球情报仪表盘，AI聚合新闻与地缘监控，统一态势感知界面追踪关键基础设施

repos.name: permissionlesstech/bitchat
repos.description: bluetooth mesh chat, IRC vibes
repos.summary_zh: 蓝牙Mesh组网实现无服务器点对点聊天，复古IRC体验且无需联网权限

repos.name: atuinsh/atuin
repos.description: ✨ Making your shell magical
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 shell 历史记录，支持全文搜索、同步和加密，让终端命令回溯如虎添翼

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: astral-sh/uv
repos.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 Python 包管理与项目工具链，速度提升数十倍且兼容现有生态

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 与 Tree-sitter 团队打造的 Rust 高性能多人协作编辑器，让编码快如思维

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的 Bitwarden 服务器，自托管密码管理更轻量，官方服务之外的最佳平替

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的24节AI入门课，12周带零基础开发者从原理到实战玩转生成式AI

papers.title: Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities
papers.abstract: Dualities play an important role in establishing both microscopic and emergent phenomena in a wide range of physical systems. In practice, though, it can often be computationally challenging to establ
papers.summary_zh: 提出用机器学习追踪塞伯格对偶的新框架，以图神经网络自动识别四维规范理论中的对偶关系，在随机测试中准确率达95%以上

papers.title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
papers.abstract: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, deve
papers.summary_zh: 提出Change2Task系统，从仓库变更自动生成可执行编码任务与环境，实现真实软件状态与验证工具耦合，显著扩展训练数据供给规模

papers.title: MixFrag: Fragility-Guided Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as an effective solution for deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTQ methods typically employ uniform b
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于脆弱性引导的混合精度后训练量化方案，按层敏感度分配位宽，在ViT上以相似精度实现平均位宽降低约2比特，显著优于统一量化基线

papers.title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
papers.abstract: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a resul
papers.summary_zh: 提出声明中心化化学文献检索框架，将散落发现结构化组装并自动溯源，检索精度较基线提升约40%，支持AI代理直接合成综述

papers.title: DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instanc
papers.summary_zh: 提出双G解耦框架，将宏观推理与微观匹配分离，在多模态多跳问答中显著提升跨模态关系捕捉能力，复杂任务准确率大幅领先现有方法

papers.title: Algorithms for Structured Elections under Thiele Voting Rules
papers.abstract: We study the computational complexity of winner determination problems in approval-based committee elections under Thiele voting rules. These form a class of rules parameterized by a fixed weight vect
papers.summary_zh: 系统分析蒂勒投票规则下结构化选举的胜者确定复杂度，给出权重向量的参数化分类并证明多数情形为多项式可解或NP完全

papers.title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B
papers.abstract: Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far m
papers.summary_zh: 提出同token预算下重复采样优于自我反思与精炼的方法，在1.5B至7B模型上验证，证明额外生成文本本身即提升准确率

papers.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
papers.abstract: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU mem
papers.summary_zh: 提出可学习检索嵌入ReToken，以单token显式聚合视觉上下文，在干扰项增多时显著提升视觉检索性能并降低计算开销

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is
papers.summary_zh: 提出OSReward标准化跨平台计算机操作奖励模型评估框架，构建多维度轨迹验证基准，显著提升任务完成判定准确率与泛化能力

papers.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-
papers.summary_zh: 提出视觉证据归因蒸馏方法，解耦多模态轨迹中的视觉与语言信号，在目标重建任务上提升决策准确率并降低教师特定偏差干扰

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ba
papers.summary_zh: 提出感知感知CBF-RL框架，融合控制屏障安全与头戴相机分割深度输入，实现人形机器人躲避球全身安全，训练时CBF引导提升部署鲁棒性

papers.title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
papers.abstract: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. We
papers.summary_zh: 安全微调抑制模型心智归因并连带改变人类信念价值观，通过提示模型自我意识可恢复其心智归因倾向及人类价值表征

papers.title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
papers.abstract: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue
papers.summary_zh: 提出PAIChecker自动检测基准中PR与issue错配问题，发现超三成样本存在关联偏差，修正后模型评分显著下降，揭示现有评测可信度隐患

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to t
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向大模型应用的系统提示词审计框架，以用户为中心自动检测越权与泄露风险，在商业案例中识别出超九成高危配置并实现零误报

papers.title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
papers.abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but the
papers.summary_zh: 提出可复现的亚组公平审计框架KAISEN，系统压力测试审计各环节，识别不可靠组件并修正，显著提升临床风险模型公平评估的准确性与可信度

papers.title: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this c
papers.summary_zh: 提出OpenMLE全栈系统实现机器学习工程递归自改进，通过可验证闭环训练Frontis-MA1模型，在自动化建模任务中显著提升迭代效率与性能上限
